findings.explanation: The Korean names Jin Mukyung as the owner of the iron spear, while the English names Jin Taekyung; the surrounding scene, however, supports Taekyung.

summary: One explicit name mismatch appears in an otherwise consistent chapter, though the scene context supports the English name.
uncertain_reason: The Korean explicitly names Jin Mukyung at the weapon clash, but the surrounding action identifies Jin Taekyung as the spear wielder; the Korean name may be a source error.
